metrics.inventory: theta*sum(w*C), rho*Kd*sum(w*C), and their sum; compare continuum and same-mesh truth separately
metrics.boundary: signed inward: J(0), -J(L); instantaneous and integrated separately
metrics.temporal_l2: trapezoidal time-weighted RMS on declared analysis_times
metrics.normalization: zero scale => relative null; scale<=reference+rounding uncertainty => near_zero absolute only; otherwise relative=abs_error/scale
metrics.order: log(E_coarse/E_fine)/log(h_coarse/h_fine); only positive resolved monotone errors with controlled other-axis contamination
